correctness.rationale: For p in S an active exponent >=2 leaves a factor p in every integer summand (n/q)*nu_q(n), contradicting target coprime to P_S. Thus exponents in S are 0 or 1; support T nonempty, n=mP_T with gcd(m,P_S)=1, and D_S(n)=m H(T). This proves necessity H(T)|y and formula; sufficiency follows since H(T)|y with y S-coprime forces y/H(T) S-coprime, so each selected T yields its own distinct support. Singleton T have H=1 and give |S| for every y; at y=1 all |T|>=2 have H>1. Max is #admissible T attained by lcm H(T), which remains S-coprime. Independently enumerated all possible n up to y max(S) for y up to 54 over four S sets; exact predicted fibers agreed and 217 example checked. Proof covers unbounded primes/targets; tests supplementary.
